MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
WITH p, t
WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
   OR (t IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Brooklyn Nets')
   OR p.nationality = 'French'
   OR (t IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers')
RETURN DISTINCT CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) AS col1,
                p.name AS col2,
                CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col3,
                p.name AS name_player
